text.uk: The US midterm elections lead, with a look at the candidates who will decide them. As Americans vote on control of Congress, DeSantis accuses Republicans of gaslighting voters over the Iran war and gas prices, and Trump says US military aid to Israel will end by the end of the year. In Britain, a well-known person loses a bid for an injunction against two news organisations, and a Reform UK councillor faces 12 rape charges.
